versions.subject: Merge PR #4760 from @X-Junior - Add new rule `Renamed NirCmd.EXE Execution`
versions.detection:
selection:
    OriginalFileName: 'NirCmd.exe'
filter_main_img:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\nircmd.exe'
        - '\nircmdc.exe'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
